A bit of a step down from the first book, but still solid. Really enjoyed the Lyrrun chapters in particular, he is still a standout character. The pacing just felt a bit more random compared to how tight the first one was. Did not think we would end at the point we did, not sure what direction the third book is going to go. Talua also was incredibly frustrating at times. I hope we get more Dellioph and Devo together.
